name: ECB EUR/USD Euro Foreign Exchange Reference Rate
description: Daily official EUR/USD foreign exchange reference rates directly from the European Central Bank (ECB) Data Portal API get_observations endpoint.

etl.script: SELECT CAST(period AS TIMESTAMP) AS period, CAST(value AS FLOAT32) AS value FROM read_json_auto('https://data-api.ecb.europa.eu/service/data/EXR/D.USD.EUR.SP00.A/get_observations?format=jsondata');
